historical_claims_to_preserve: v5 combines collect and confirm for payment, setup intents and refunds. Existing two-step payment methods still work, unified payment is recommended, and the two-step refund methods are deprecated.
Customer cancellation is enabled by default on supported readers, with iOS enum and Android DISABLE_IF_AVAILABLE opt-out. Preserve reconnect state and nil/null qualifications separately by SDK.

iOS v5 raises the minimum to iOS 15, while existing iOS 4.x still supports iOS 14+. Retain the pre-singleton token-provider initialization and use of discovery builders. Android init requires a nullable OfflineListener, and the Kotlin coroutine module is optional.

Interac refunds using a PaymentIntent ID require its clientSecret. The charge-ID path does not require it. Android Apps on Devices renames the Handoff classes and Maven artifact and Stripe says it will no longer update the old artifact.

Historical Android Tap to Pay requirements cover SDK 5.0.0+, Android 13+, hardware-backed key agreement, and the production-only discovery failure for enabled debug options with its simulated-reader exception. Discover acceptance is labeled public preview in the v5 overview.
